'''Parson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] aboard the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] [[Tyrant (Harrower-class)|''Tyrant'']]. When the [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion]] of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] arrived at the ''Tyrant'', Parson attempted to confiscate the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter's]] weapons, but the hunter refused and Parson was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the conflict.<ref name="TOR" />
